method: The harness runs once per side over the 17 variants that block no reader, and once per (variant, probe) in its own process group under a 120 s kill timeout for the two that can block or exhaust the base reader (a FIFO; a symbolic link to /dev/zero). The base side writes the subject files from the base commit over the fix, then the fix is restored. The three base probes that read the marker through the link to /dev/zero (allow-execution, launchFormRefusal, launch-form) are not run: the base reader follows the link and reads without bound (R-GP-IMPL-LAUNCHED-MARKER-1 3.5 observed std::bad_alloc under prlimit). Each variant plants launched.json in a fresh run directory at a fixed path per probe; probes are public entry points present at both commits.
command: python3 drive.py <worktree> <base> <scratch> <out.json>; the harness is copied to packages/polaris-dossier/src/zz-b88-differential.test.ts and run with B88_BASE, B88_OUT and optionally B88_SKIP, B88_ONLY_VARIANT, B88_ONLY_PROBE set: npx vitest run --project @syzygy/polaris-dossier packages/polaris-dossier/src/zz-b88-differential.test.ts
